prompts.name: 01-long-recurve
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Korean fantasy MMORPG weapon redesign concept for user review, not a final game asset. Input image 1 is a STYLE AND MATERIAL reference of the user's current H03 bow. Produce exactly ONE full length bow per image. Keep the recognizable luminous deep sapphire / ice blue translucent crystalline horn material, restrained champagne gold metal filigree, midnight blue wrapped short center grip, and one small luminous crescent accent. Change the silhouette substantially toward a beautiful tall LONG BOW: long upper AND lower limbs, grip at the vertical middle, both functional nocks joined by one clearly visible taut straight bowstring on the right. The upper and lower limbs together form a coherent bent C / recurve bow body on the left of the string with large open draw space. The string ends attach to the actual extreme tips, not to a short secondary branch. No oversized crown above the grip, no staff-like straight central pole, no wand, no disconnected pieces, no arrow. Upper/lower balance is crucial. At least 80% of total height is graceful slender curved limbs, not ornament. Make it visually read as an archer's weapon even at a small MMO gameplay size. Fine hand painted polished game weapon concept rendering matching the reference, detailed but clean silhouette, subdued magical glow with crisp physical edges. Full weapon upright in a portrait composition, all tips in frame with generous margin, plain dark navy background, centered, no text, no labels, no user interface, no montage, no additional objects. Design A: restrained elegant lunar recurve longbow. The closest family resemblance to the reference but much longer and balanced above/below the grip. Two smooth tapering sapphire limbs sweep outward to the left then recurve to the right at the tips. Small swept horn fins at each outer quarter, three at most, no branching antler crown. Gold flows as a thin structural edge along the crystal. Small inset crescent is tucked into the riser just above the grip and does not occupy a huge oval. Approximately 5:1 full height to max bow-body width; overall height approximately 1.45 times the reference relative to the same handgrip size. Sleek, noble, practical tension-bearing arc.
